name: Employee-owned acquisition entity path
description: A new entity owned by employees is formed to acquire the company. Structured per Employee Ownership Journey v0.2's acquisition-entity path; seeded values are starting points to confirm or replace.

seed_assumptions.name: Acquisition entity holds the shares
seed_assumptions.description: The working assumption that a newly formed employee-owned entity, not the employees individually, holds the company's shares.

seed_assumptions.name: Employee-owners govern through elected representatives
seed_assumptions.description: The working assumption that the entity's governance gives employee-owners representation rather than direct day-to-day votes.

seed_assumptions.name: Entity forms before the purchase agreement
seed_assumptions.description: The working sequencing: the acquisition entity exists and is funded before any purchase agreement is signed.

seed_unknowns.description: The entity form and its formation cost are undecided; this path cannot be priced without them.
seed_unknowns.required_action: Have counsel propose entity options and formation steps for the acquisition vehicle.

seed_unknowns.description: Lender appetite for a newly formed employee-owned acquisition vehicle is unknown.
